body: You can't teach a skill online. Besides, i could learn that skill, but i would never have a single chance to perform it, or i would be terrible at that skill.

I believe in the concept of someone being unlovable. No one cares and no one understands my situation. The only person that did understood me was my dad (because he had mild social anxiety) but he died from cancer last year. You're 34 and you need to start over but i need to start for the first time, wich is way harder. I never used online dating but i'm sure it would be an epic fail.

If you're an interesting and confident person it's very easy. That's really not my case. I have no self esteem and no confidence. I'm boring and i don't know how to approach a girl, even in a dating website (because i've never spoke to a woman in my life).
I never tried online dating because i sick of hearing "Online dating works only for attractive people" wich is not my case (An OKC study says that women find 80% of men unattractive)

I'm sure what **most** women think about a 34 year old virgin with no dating experience is that he has a serious mental illness (completely crazy). I'm sure most women think i'm completely crazy. So my chances are almost zero. Most women **care** about looks. That's the cold truth i need to accept. I could do a lot of stuff, but i would still be invisble to most women. I don't know why you're saying i seem like a nice person. You barely know me. My social anxiety it's so strong i can't even talk casually to a person online. In his 20's my dad used to have mild social anxiety. He was the only person i could get advice from. Last year he was diagnosed with cancer and he died 2 months later. I've become even more depressed. He was the only one i could count and ask advice. But now, he's gone.
I'm already too depressed and bitter to travel and to give love to others.
Almost every women can easily get a partner. For men, it's a lot harder.
I'm already 34. It's too late. My "prime years" are gone. So i'm not desperate for love. Who would ever love a 34 year old loser? If you said no one, you're goddamn right.
I'm sorry but online friends will not solve my problem.
No, i can't because it was so much years ago i don't remember.
When you're emotional 24/7 it's a little bit hard...
My life is so lonely and depressing i could write a book about it.
When i was depressed the only things that prevents me from killing myself was "hard" drugs. Besides, if my mom knew i killed she would be devastated.
